name: Lake Suite
description: Our signature suite opens onto a private balcony above Havenmere Lake. Morning light fills the room; evenings settle into deep quiet. A freestanding tub, linen bedding, and a writing desk face the shoreline.

name: Forest King
tagline: Wrapped in cedar and soft light
description: A generous king room tucked into the treeline. Warm wood paneling, a reading nook, and a walk-in shower make this the quietest stay on property. Ideal for couples who want stillness without sacrificing comfort.

name: Harbor Twin
tagline: Two beds, one calm harbor outlook
description: Designed for friends or family traveling together. Twin beds, a shared lounge alcove, and a view toward the marina. Flexible for longer stays with a compact kitchenette and ample closet space.

name: Meadow Cottage
tagline: A freestanding cabin at the edge of the field
description: Our only freestanding cottage—separate entrance, wood-burning fireplace, and a porch that looks across wild meadow. Perfect when you want the hotel’s dining and spa with the privacy of a small house.
